[OZBsince2018] I had this phone for a few months. Battery time is below average even for normal daily use. Otherwise a very good phone specially for those who want to have a small size flagship level device.
[bobbycr] I had this in my cart a few days ago, and with all the coupons I had applied, the total came down to $712. When I logged back in yesterday, my cart was empty and I'd lost all the coupon codes since I hadn't saved them anywhere else.
I contacted customer support, and the agent said they clear carts when an item goes out of stock. Unfortunately, they couldn't help recover the coupon codes either.
Oh well, whatever happens, happens for a reason. I'll just wait for the Pixel deals instead.
